verdict.rationale: Mastra is Apache 2.0 licensed, self-hostable for $0/month, deployable to any Node.js-compatible environment or runtime (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare), and explicitly markets 'build and host agents anywhere' with no vendor lock-in for core hosting. missing for 10: no independent case study confirming a production fully self-hosted deployment, and a community note flags the license restricts reselling as a hosted service (not a self-hosting restriction, but a licensing nuance worth noting).
